summary: The actual monthly files were audited for SCHLCOLL, invalid/not-in-universe codes were never treated as nonenrolled, and the common-observable older sample correctly ends at age 54. Restricting young workers to nonenrolled changes the pooled coefficient by 0.0082 against ages 26-65 and by 0.0053 on the common 22-54 universe; all paired occupation- and family-clustered intervals contain zero. These are selected-population descriptions, not causal corrections.
